name: us29-feature-reuse-yes-no-issues-multi
description: 029 contract §3.1 (FR-034): the which-issues follow-up carries EVERY detected issue, not only the leading one, and each with the same per-issue facts the reuse question states — role (never absent, null here since the project declares no hierarchy), halted (never null), key, summary, type, status. Regression pin: the fallback used to rebuild the payload from the leading key alone, dropping the other two detections and stripping the survivor of summary/type/status. Byte-identical across ports.
